Bug_Details:
Category: Concurrency. Reported as "GuardedBy Violation" by racerd.

A field annotated with @GuardedBy is being accessed by a call-chain that starts at a non-private method without synchronization.

Example:

class C {  @GuardedBy("this")  String f;  void foo(String s) {    f = s; // unprotected access here  }}

Action: Protect the offending access by acquiring the lock indicated by the @GuardedBy(...).
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the `foo` method where a field annotated with @GuardedBy is being accessed without synchronization. This violates the guarantees provided by the @GuardedBy annotation.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case 'testGuardedByViolation' creates two threads that simultaneously call the'showBug' method of the 'GuardedByBug' class. Since the 'foo' method of 'GuardedByBug' class is not synchronized, there is no guarantee that one thread will finish updating the 'f' field before the other thread tries to read it. This violates the @GuardedBy annotation and leads to unpredictable results, causing the test case to fail.
